new.brief: Creates a new selection to handle `model`.
new.md: Creates a new selection to handle `model`.

doc.brief: A selection model that allows selecting a single item.
doc.md:
A selection model that allows selecting a single item.

Note that the selection is *persistent* -- if the selected item is removed
and re-added in the same [`ListModel::items-changed`](xref:gtk:Gio.ListModel#event:items-changed) emission, it
stays selected. In particular, this means that changing the sort order of an
underlying sort model will preserve the selection.

get_autoselect.brief: Checks if autoselect has been enabled or disabled via gtk_single_selection_set_autoselect().
get_autoselect.md:
Checks if autoselect has been enabled or disabled via
gtk_single_selection_set_autoselect().

get_can_unselect.brief: If `TRUE`, gtk_selection_model_unselect_item() is supported and allows unselecting the selected item.
get_can_unselect.md:
If `TRUE`, gtk_selection_model_unselect_item() is supported and allows
unselecting the selected item.

get_model.brief: Gets the model that `self` is wrapping.
get_model.md: Gets the model that `self` is wrapping.

get_selected.brief: Gets the position of the selected item.
get_selected.md:
Gets the position of the selected item.

If no item is selected, %GTK_INVALID_LIST_POSITION is returned.

get_selected_item.md:
Gets the selected item.

If no item is selected, `NULL` is returned.

set_autoselect.md:
Enables or disables autoselect.

If `autoselect` is `TRUE`, `self` will enforce that an item is always
selected. It will select a new item when the currently selected
item is deleted and it will disallow unselecting the current item.

set_can_unselect.brief: If `TRUE`, unselecting the current item via gtk_selection_model_unselect_item() is supported.
set_can_unselect.md:
If `TRUE`, unselecting the current item via
gtk_selection_model_unselect_item() is supported.

Note that setting [`SingleSelection:autoselect`](xref:gtk:Gtk.SingleSelection#property:autoselect) will
cause unselecting to not work, so it practically makes no sense
to set both at the same time.

set_model.brief: Sets the model that `self` should wrap.
set_model.md:
Sets the model that `self` should wrap.

If `model` is `NULL`, `self` will be empty.

set_selected.brief: Selects the item at the given position.
set_selected.md:
Selects the item at the given position.

If the list does not have an item at `position` or
%GTK_INVALID_LIST_POSITION is given, the behavior depends on the
value of the [`SingleSelection:autoselect`](xref:gtk:Gtk.SingleSelection#property:autoselect) property:
If it is set, no change will occur and the old item will stay
selected. If it is unset, the selection will be unset and no item
will be selected. This also applies if [`SingleSelection:can-unselect`](xref:gtk:Gtk.SingleSelection#property:can-unselect)
is set to `FALSE`.

autoselect.brief: If the selection will always select an item.
autoselect.md: If the selection will always select an item.

can-unselect.brief: If unselecting the selected item is allowed.
can-unselect.md: If unselecting the selected item is allowed.
